searchText: In Genesis File Format EIP https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7949 1. config timestamps are integers, but genesis timestamp is hexUint 2. imho, the entire format can work well without `hexUint` by using decimal numbers instead. gasLimit, nonce, balance would look better. `*difficulty` readability would not suffer a lot cc <@827653956955406406> <@508125616940515329> <@412614104222531604> we good to merge https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/719 ?

excerpts.content:
In Genesis File Format EIP https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7949 
1. config timestamps are integers, but genesis timestamp is hexUint
2. imho, the entire format can work well without `hexUint` by using decimal numbers instead. gasLimit, nonce, balance would look better. `*difficulty` readability would not suffer a lot
